headline_finding.strict_mode_summary: With MLB Spring Training & NFL Preseason included, there is NO 2-week (14+ day) or 3-week (21+ day) zero-sports window in 2027, 2028, or 2029 — HOWEVER, because the NFL officially discontinued the Pro Bowl game beginning 2026–27, there IS a 13-day (1-week+) zero-game stretch every early February (Feb 1–13, 2027; est. Jan 31–Feb 12, 2028; est. Jan 29–Feb 10, 2029), plus a 4-day post-Super Bowl gap (Feb 15–18, 2027) before Spring Training opens Feb 19!
headline_finding.regular_season_mode_summary: Excluding Spring Training & Preseason exhibitions, a massive 5-to-6+ week completely zero-sports window opens EVERY year immediately after the Super Bowl: 37 consecutive days in 2027 (Mon Feb 15 – Tue Mar 23, VERIFIED), ~45 consecutive days in 2028 (Mon Feb 14 – Wed Mar 29, SB LXII verified / MLB est.), and ~45 consecutive days in 2029 (Mon Feb 12 – Wed Mar 28, est.) — ideal for 1-week, 2-week, or 3-week vacations!
headline_finding.lockout_wildcard: MLB's CBA expires Dec 1, 2026. If a lockout delays 2027 Spring Training beyond Feb 19, 2027, the strict-mode Feb–Mar 2027 window could expand into a multi-week zero-sports stretch.
